entities.name: PMID:25098666
observations: Primary study reports that TNFα and IL-6 signaling contribute to loss of hepatic-specific markers during HepaRG tumor-derived hepatocyte-like cell retrodifferentiation; TGFβ1 induces EMT. Pathway-specific activation/inhibition supported these roles.

entities.name: Cytokines promote hepatic retrodifferentiation
observations: In HepaRG tumor-derived hepatocyte-like cells, TNFα and IL-6 pathways contribute to loss of hepatic markers during transition toward bipotent progenitors; TGFβ1 promotes EMT. Evidence is in vitro and model-specific.
